dogecoin.text:
There are now thousands of cryptocurrencies, from Ethereum to Litecoin to Dogecoin. Together, they’re worth a staggering half a trillion dollars.  

But are they here to stay? Watch the latest episode of Explained on @netflix for more: https://t.co/XMktthK7Sl

Today, anyone can buy cryptocurrency. Billions are being poured into bitcoin and even Dogecoin – but what exactly are people buying? 

Watch the latest episode of Explained, narrated by @ChristianSlater, for more: https://t.co/XMktthK7Sl
